acknowledged_notes.detail: 4 perimeter deck(s) totalling 2688 m close a loop and carry no interior cover (longest cover-free run 736 m >176 m) — an open sprint lane by design, never the only route between two districts
acknowledged_notes.rationale: The outer service ring is an intentionally open perimeter sprint lane. It is never the only route between two districts (validate_level_flow proves no articulation corridor), four authored ring encounters patrol it, and nothing in the shipped combat data engages beyond 22 m or sees beyond 30 m — an open lane cannot be shot down its length. Cover lives inside the twelve districts the ring connects.
